# Brand logos

These SVGs identify the services Blaze connects to. Each logo is a trademark of its
owner and is used only to show which service a row or tile is about; it does not
mean the owner endorses Blaze. Follow each brand's guidelines if you reuse them.

| File | Source | Licence of the SVG | Colour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| github, spotify, notion, mcp (Model Context Protocol), gemini (Google Gemini), openrouter, mistral (Mistral AI), nvidia, deepseek, moonshot (Kimi), anthropic, ollama | [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons) v16.34.0 | CC0 1.0 | Simple Icons brand hex |
| slack, openai | Simple Icons v13.21.0 (removed from later releases) | CC0 1.0 | Simple Icons brand hex (Slack #4A154B, OpenAI #412991) |
| google | Google's "Sign in with Google" G mark (developers.google.com/identity/branding-guidelines) | Google brand asset | Google's four colours |
| groq | groq.com/favicon.svg | Groq brand asset | as published |
| xai | docs.x.ai favicon (x.ai) | xAI brand asset | as published |
| cerebras | the mark from the logo on cerebras.ai | Cerebras brand asset | #F15A29 + ink |

Brand guidelines: GitHub https://github.com/logos · Spotify https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/design ·
Google https://about.google/brand-resource-center/ · Slack https://slack.com/brand-guidelines ·
OpenAI https://openai.com/brand · Kimi https://moonshotai.github.io/Branding-Guide

Simple Icons' own disclaimer applies: "We ask that all users read our legal disclaimer
before using icons from Simple Icons" (https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/DISCLAIMER.md).
A custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint and local MCP commands have no logo and use Blaze line marks.
